description: Use this when the user asks what a domain extension is, what it means, who runs it, who can register it, or whether it fits their project ("is .ai good for a startup", "what is .io", "does .web exist"). Returns tld.expert’s editorial verdict, pros and cons, registry, registration restrictions, the use cases it ranks for, and a typical price. Also answers for well-known non-existent TLDs like .eth or .web.

tld.description: A TLD without or with the dot, e.g. "ai" or ".io"

name: explain_tld
title: Explain a TLD
